label: expelled or deported
definition: Authority or acting group X forcibly expelled or deported person Y or explicitly affected members of population Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit expulsion or deportation by X of Y; historical forced removal of identified members of a population. Excludes: barring entry without removal; ordinary voluntary departure; killing, occupation or criticism alone; assuming every member of a named population was expelled. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear expelling authority or affected people; proposed expulsion without established action; leaving under pressure without an explicit expulsion or deportation. Direction is expelling authority to affected person/population. The source territory is a separate omitted role; this does not identify a destination.

facts.reason: Israel → Palestinians: Explicit deporting and expelling Palestinians establishes forced removal of affected members of that population; this does not claim all Palestinians were expelled.

review.method: Explicit manual judgment after reading the full relation dictionary and every supplied case row; citations include the complete considered evidence.
